name: nxk
description: Research on people for Claude: who would want something, how many of them there are, where they live, and every breakdown, counted on 200,000 made-up adults a country (UK and US) from PersonaGen, matched to official statistics. /nxk:research puts your question to the whole country and returns findings; /nxk:look has a second look at a page, policy, letter or plan and comes back with at most three points worth considering; /nxk:meet draws a few of the people behind a count, as cards of their own facts. Every figure says where it came from.

gemini_api_key.title: Google AI Studio key
gemini_api_key.description: For scans through Google's decision model, gemini-decision-1 (recommended). Empty: GEMINI_API_KEY or ~/.config/nxk/gemini-key is used if set.

gemini_tier.title: Google tier
gemini_tier.description: Your Google AI Studio project's tier (aistudio.google.com/projects shows it). It sets how fast scans go: Tier 1 is 20 times the Free Tier. Not set keeps to the Free Tier's limits.

gateway_api_key.title: Vercel AI Gateway key
gateway_api_key.description: For decision models through Vercel AI Gateway (Gemini Decision 1, Jev and others).

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter key
openrouter_api_key.description: For decision models through OpenRouter's decisions endpoint, which OpenRouter marks as alpha.

decision_model.title: Decision model
decision_model.description: gemini-decision-1 (recommended), or another decision model your gateway or OpenRouter serves. Answers are kept apart by model.

scan_budget.title: Scan budget (US dollars)
scan_budget.description: Optional: the most nxk may spend on scans for one request without asking you first, such as 0.50. Empty: it asks before every paid scan.

personagen_api_key.title: PersonaGen key
personagen_api_key.description: Optional: lets people_pull draw more people for an audience too narrow for the 200,000 shipped.
